notes: Job TRANREPT step STEP10R: the daily transaction report over CardDemo's own posted transactions. transact.txt is the TRANSACT file POSTTRAN (CBTRN02C) writes from the corpus's daily transactions and data (the carddemo-posttran case's COBOL output, processed 2022-07-18), sorted by TRAN-CARD-NUM as STEP05R's SORT does (stable); the LAST record's TRAN-PROC-TS is moved to 2022-08-01, outside the report's range, so the program's range check sends it to NEXT SENTENCE -- which leaves the whole PERFORM ... END-PERFORM. sentence: the report stops there, without its grand totals (the program's defect; STEP05R's INCLUDE would have dropped the record); dateparm.txt is the DATEPARM record for July 2022, which the SORT's INCLUDE and the program's own range check both read. Every other input is the corpus's data. Derived from CardDemo (Apache-2.0; Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates): LICENSE and NOTICE here are the source's own.
